status: Archived aggregate output from the original paired CPU profiling run; not a rerun.
scope: Warm prepare_triangle_frame CPU time only; no GPU rendering or completion.
method: Three warmups, then 40 samples per variant in alternating order, sharing each scene and its warmed mesh cache. The recompute variant calls geometry.pixel_error on every hit; the memoized variant uses _MeshEntry.pixel_error. Setup and method patching are outside timed intervals.
raw_sample_availability: Individual per-frame timing samples were held only in the original Python process and were not retained. These medians/p95 values and cache counters are copied exactly from that run's captured JSON console output. p95 is sorted(samples)[37] for 40 samples, as in the attached reproduction script.
